items.caption: Modern rendering of the seal-style form of 刀, the phonetic component in the usual analysis of 到.
items.alt: A thick black seal-style 刀 form on a white background, redrawn as a modern vector.
items.selection_reason: This identifies the phonetic component named in the standard analysis; it illustrates 刀 only and does not show 到’s historical form or establish the disputed graphic interpretation.

limitations.text: This seal-style rendering shows 刀, not 到. The competing accounts of 到’s older form—至 plus 刀, or 人 plus 至 with 人 reinterpreted as 刀—remain unresolved, and no verified 到 glyph is shown here.
